title: Day 30 or 31 invoiced in January 2028 falls on Feb 29
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure work order 1 is complete and ready to invoice (every part received, review done), for a customer who holds the shop's own term due on day 31 of the following month.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Jan 20, 2028.
  3. Set Invoice Date to Jan 31, 2028.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice preview shows Invoice Date and Due date.

Step 2:

  • The Due date reads Feb 29, 2028 (2028 is a leap year; February has 29 days).

Step 3:

  • The Due date reads Feb 29, 2028 (invoice on the last day of January).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R3: “When the following month is shorter than the term's day, the due date is that month's last day: day 31 invoiced in October is due Nov 30; day 30 or 31 invoiced in January is due Feb 28 (Feb 29 in a leap year); day 31 invoiced in March is due Apr 30.”
